messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
Memory: one remembered fact per line, with the dates it held and the note that recorded it. An indented "earlier" line is a version of the fact above it that was later corrected.
- Team Dune observed that the indexer's disk usage jumped 30 percent after the retention change. (since 2026-06-09; source standup/dune/2026-06-09)
- [decision] As of 2026-06-04, Priya Raman has the Atlas team pager this cycle, taking over from Marcus. (since 2026-06-04; source standup/atlas/2026-06-04)
- The Atlas team noticed that the indexer's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the owners. (since 2026-05-27; source standup/atlas/2026-05-27)
- [decision] As of 2026-05-27, the bus will retain messages for seven days, since replaying a full week has covered every incident recovery so far. (since 2026-05-27; source standup/atlas/2026-05-27)
- The Dune team planning meeting is every Wednesday. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-4)
  - earlier: The Atlas team planning meeting is every Tuesday. (held 2025-09-30 to 2026-05-22; source standup/atlas/2025-09-30)
- The Dune team planning meeting is every Wednesday. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-4)
- As of 2026-05-22, the job scheduler's error rate crept up to 2 percent after the dependency bump, per a heads-up from team Dune. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-3)
- Team Dune noticed that the auth gateway's CPU sat at 90 percent after the traffic shift and pinged the auth gateway's owners. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22-2)
- As of 2026-05-22, Tomasz is the primary on-call for team Dune, having taken over from Farah. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22)
  - earlier: As of 2026-04-14, Farah is the primary on-call for team Dune, having taken over from Tomasz. (held 2026-04-14 to 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-04-14)
  - earlier: As of 2026-03-11, Tomasz is the primary on-call for team Dune, having taken over from Farah. (held 2026-03-11 to 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-03-11)
  - earlier: As of 2026-01-16, Farah is the primary on-call for team Dune. (held 2026-01-16 to 2026-03-11; source standup/dune/2026-01-16)
- As of 2026-05-22, Tomasz holds the Dune pager for team Dune this cycle, having taken over from Farah. (since 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-05-22)
  - earlier: As of 2026-04-14, Farah holds the Dune pager for team Dune this cycle, having taken over from Tomasz. (held 2026-04-14 to 2026-05-22; source standup/dune/2026-04-14)
- The ledger service is not the Atlas team's service, so the Atlas team flagged the ledger service. (since 2026-04-16; source standup/atlas/2026-04-16)
- The Atlas team observed that the ledger service's disk usage jumped 30 percent following the retention change. (since 2026-04-16; source standup/atlas/2026-04-16)
- Farah is the release captain for Q3 2025. (since 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-04-14-3)
- Team Dune noticed that the reporting service's p99 latency doubled after Tuesday's deploy and pinged the reporting service's owners. (since 2026-04-14; source standup/dune/2026-04-14-2)
- The reporting service is owned by the Ember team. (since 2026-04-13; source standup/ember/2026-04-13-2)
- As of 2026-04-13, the Ember team still owns the reporting service. (since 2026-04-13; source standup/ember/2026-04-13-2)
- [preference] As of 2026-04-08, for anything Atlas team-related this cycle, page Marcus, not Priya Raman. (since 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-04-08)
- webhooks is not the Atlas team's service, so the Atlas team flagged webhooks. (since 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-04-08)
- The Atlas team noticed that webhooks' request volume halved following the client rollout. (since 2026-04-08; source standup/atlas/2026-04-08)
- [constraint] As of 2026-04-01, the indexer is owned by the Boreal team, taking over from the Atlas team. (since 2026-04-01; source handover/2026-04-01-search-indexer)
